title: Store Book ID and Name as Key-Value Pairs

blocks.content: Store Book ID and Name as Key-Value Pairs
Write a program to store the id and name of books as a key-value pair.

items: Initialize a map called book of integer key and string value with the key-value pairs {101, "Pale Blue Dot"} and {102, "A Brief History of Time"}.
Print the map using first for keys and second for values.

blocks.content:
Expected Output101 - Pale Blue Dot
102 - A Brief History of Time
